svg.text: Flow of control runs from controllers to interactors to presenters to views; dependencies mostly point the other way, toward higher-level policy, across double-line
split per actor (and Catalog View and

Two dimensions of separation (1) actors, from the Single Responsibility Principle:
components that change for different reasons; (2) the Dependency Rule: components
at different levels of policy, changing at different rates
using relationships (open arrows) point with the flow of control; inheritance
(closed arrows) points against it: the Open-Closed Principle keeps changes to low-
level details from rippling upward to high-level policy
Each component is a potential .jar or .dll: build them separately, then group into fewer deliverables (five: views, presenters, interactors, controllers, utilities; or
views and presenters together with everything else together; or just two) and regroup as the system changes
